subject.title: feat(gateway): add operator killswitch to pause/abort agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw support a persisted gateway-wide emergency pause with a hard-coded owner-only Signal stop/resume phrase as a core operator contract?
rationale: This creates durable safety state, new admin API/CLI surface, and a remote channel control whose authorization, fail-open, and recovery semantics are not established by current product contracts.

options.title: Sponsor a generic core control
options.body: Approve a channel-agnostic emergency-pause contract and require canonical admission, complete abort coverage, safe persistence semantics, and live security proof.

options.title: Narrow to admin control
options.body: Approve CLI/admin RPC first while deferring Signal phrases until a portable typed operator-action and channel-ownership design exists.

options.title: Keep existing stop paths
options.body: Decline the persistent control and retain daemon stop, per-run abort, and cooperative host suspension as the supported mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a generic core control
recommendation.body: Approve a channel-agnostic emergency-pause contract and require canonical admission, complete abort coverage, safe persistence semantics, and live security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-level history is the adjacent cooperative gateway suspension and stop behavior.
